mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing temperatures around 67 degrees under overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School, currently in the third quarter moon phase.

The City of Verona has several updates, including the Senior Center's tri-shaw bike program which offers free, volunteer-piloted rides on the Military Ridge State Trail. Additionally, the Recreation Department is hiring for various seasonal roles, and homeowners can now apply for rebates on rain barrel installations.

There is plenty to do, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market today at Hometown Junction Park. Later today, you can enjoy pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company or test your knowledge at Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and Hop Haus trivia.
Regarding local activity, a noteworthy call occurred on July 31 when a driver was arrested for O W I after being stopped for an equipment violation.

If you are craving something sweet, today's flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM today. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
